mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe how the different elements interact/co-operate to achieve a desired goal."
The systems approach is used to describe how the different elements interact/co-operate to achieve a desired goal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most complex human endeavours imaginable."
Teaching is one of the most complex human endeavours imaginable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a wholistic way of viewing the entire teaching-learning process."
Systems approach to instruction is a wholistic way of viewing the entire teaching-learning process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phase of interaction among learners, teachers, materials, media, mode and content."
The micro level is a phase of interaction among learners, teachers, materials, media, mode and content.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systemic and systematic application of strategies and techniques derived from behavioral, cognitive, and constructivist theories to the solution of instructional problems."

Instructional technology is the systemic and systematic application of strategies and techniques derived from behavioral, cognitive, and constructivist theories to the solution of instructional problems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic process of designing, developing ,managing and evaluating the entire instructional process to ensure effective and efficient learning."
Instructional design is the systematic process of designing, developing ,managing and evaluating the entire instructional process to ensure effective and efficient learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of rounding off a lesson."
Closure is a process of rounding off a lesson.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the opposite of deterministic systems."
Probabilistic systems are the opposite of deterministic systems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with a wide area of interest."
Psychology is concerned with a wide area of interest.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the level of educational system that refers to the activities of the educational institution relating to the translation of the policy encoded in national objectives into institutional objectives."

The meso level is the level of educational system that refers to the activities of the educational institution relating to the translation of the policy encoded in national objectives into institutional objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that has been variously conceptualized and defined by various authors."
System is a term that has been variously conceptualized and defined by various authors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the steps into which the method is divided."
Content refers to the steps into which the method is divided.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex set of patterns operating in the various psychomotor, cognitive, and effective domains of communication behavior."
Underlying even a brief utterance is a complex set of patterns operating in the various psychomotor, cognitive, and effective domains of communication behavior.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process whereby a given a problem is broken down into bits It is at this stage that the actual problem is identified and analyzed with a view of setting goals and objectives."
System analysis is a process whereby a given a problem is broken down into bits It is at this stage that the actual problem is identified and analyzed with a view of setting goals and objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as a learning theory based on authentic and real-world situations."
Constructivism is described as a learning theory based on authentic and real-world situations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of analyzing and articulating the kind of learning that you expect the learners to know how to perform (Jonassen, Tessmer, & Hannum, 1999)."
Task analysis for instructional design is a process of analyzing and articulating the kind of learning that you expect the learners to know how to perform (Jonassen, Tessmer, & Hannum, 1999).
